rules: Losses attach to existing entities/populations; they are not flavor text.
Destroyed ships/facilities remain unavailable until a valid recovery/reconstruction event.
Deaths and injuries use existing personnel/consequence systems.
Prisoners remain persistent characters/populations with location/custody state.
Refugee/evacuation movements conserve population and delegate to population_movement_contract.
Civilian harm feeds diplomatic, legal, reputation and political consequences without assigning morality from species.
